body:
Source: the release review of v1.11.1..main. Re-verified on claude-review @ e4b58abe:
- plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/adlc-lifecycle.mjs and plugins/adlc-copilot/hooks/adlc-lifecycle.mjs: run() calls `spawnImpl(bin, args, { cwd, encoding: 'utf8' })` with no timeout; gitChangedPaths issues up to eight git calls through it, stopReview runs `adlc gate-manifest show` through it, and verifyOutput spawns `adlc gate-manifest verify` with no timeout. A `git` or `adlc` that never exits holds the hook until the host's per-hook timeout, and forever for any direct caller (tests, scripts).
- plugins/adlc-cursor/hooks/adlc-stop.mjs: the same unbounded run()/gitChangedPaths shape, plus the verify/show adlc calls in stopAudit.
- plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/adlc-build-gate.mjs and plugins/adlc-copilot/hooks/adlc-build-gate.mjs: recordBuildGateBypass spawns `adlc gate-manifest record build-gate-bypass` with no timeout, so a wedged recorder holds an enforcing PreToolUse hook instead of denying promptly.
- plugins/adlc-copilot/hooks/adlc-build-gate.mjs: recordBuildGateBypass runs a bare PATH-resolved `adlc` with the hook's full environment, so a `node_modules/.bin/adlc` ahead of the real install receives ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY and ADLC_ADMIN_KEY. The Codex recorder already resolves a trusted binary and passes an allowlisted environment.
- scripts/test/hook-spawn-timeout-drift.test.mjs scans only plugins/*/hooks/test, while cursor, gemini, copilot, pi, opencode and herdr keep the tests that spawn their hooks in plugins/*/test. Its detector misses `spawnSync('node', ...)`, `process.argv[0]` and execSync/exec command lines, and returns no sites for a module it cannot parse.
Repro: put a `git` that runs `exec sleep 100000` first on PATH and run `node plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/adlc-lifecycle.mjs review` in an ADLC repo: it never returns.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. The reference shape is plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/adlc-hook.mjs: runAdlc passes `timeout: 5000, killSignal: 'SIGKILL'`, and gitChangedPaths gives each git call the remainder of one 5000 ms scan budget floored at 1 ms (spawnSync reads `timeout: 0` as unbounded). The Codex recorder's trusted-binary pattern is resolveTrustedBinary + RECOVERY_AUDIT_ENV_ALLOWLIST in plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/adlc-handoff-gate.mjs; Copilot hooks run from the installed plugin with no node_modules, so they inline it. Hook-spawning tests must go through each directory's helpers/run-hook.mjs. Tests: `node --test plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/test/*.test.mjs`, `node --test plugins/adlc-copilot/hooks/test/*.test.mjs plugins/adlc-copilot/test/*.test.mjs`, `node --test plugins/adlc-cursor/test/*.test.mjs`.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. Every git/adlc spawn in the Codex and Copilot lifecycle hooks and the Cursor stop hook carries `killSignal: 'SIGKILL'` and a timeout: 5000 ms per adlc call, and one 5000 ms budget shared across the git calls of one changed-path scan, never below 1 ms. A timed-out call is a failed call: the scan returns what it gathered, verify reports a failed verification, the advisory hooks never block.
2. recordBuildGateBypass in the Codex and Copilot build gates passes `timeout: 5000, killSignal: 'SIGKILL'`; a killed recorder returns false, so the gate denies (fail closed).
3. Copilot's recordBuildGateBypass resolves `adlc` skipping every PATH entry inside node_modules and any file not owned by this uid, runs the realpath through process.execPath, and passes only an exported allowlist (PATH, HOME, NODE_PATH, TMPDIR, TMP, TEMP, LANG, LC_ALL, USER, LOGNAME). No trusted binary means false (deny), never a bare-PATH fallback.
4. The raw-Node-spawn ban covers every plugins/*/test and plugins/*/hooks/test directory on disk. Files that already spawn Node directly are pinned by exact count in a shrink-only map; a new raw spawn anywhere reds. The detector recognises `node`, `process.argv[0]` and node-headed execSync/exec command lines, and reports an unparseable module as a violation.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 Codex lifecycle and build-gate spawns are bounded and fail closed on a killed recorder. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/test/spawn-bounds.test.mjs`
- AC2 Copilot lifecycle and build-gate spawns are bounded, and the bypass recorder never passes the manifest or admin key and skips node_modules. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-copilot/hooks/test/spawn-bounds.test.mjs`
- AC3 The Cursor stop hook's spawns are bounded. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-cursor/test/stop-spawn-bounds.test.mjs`
- AC4 The detector recognises the new Node spawn shapes and reports unparseable modules; the ban scans every plugin test directory. verify: `node --test scripts/test/raw-spawn-sites.test.mjs scripts/test/hook-spawn-timeout-drift.test.mjs`
- AC5 Existing plugin suites stay green. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/test/*.test.mjs && node --test plugins/adlc-copilot/hooks/test/*.test.mjs plugins/adlc-copilot/test/*.test.mjs && node --test plugins/adlc-cursor/test/*.test.mjs`
- AC6 Mutation gate green on the branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0

OUT OF SCOPE: plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/adlc-hook.mjs (its runAdlc passes the full environment to a PATH-resolved adlc by design, so that bypass records are signed; changing it is a separate decision about signed chains); converting the files pinned in the shrink-only map; plugins/adlc-cursor/hooks/adlc-preflight.mjs's unbounded `adlc preflight` spawn.
title: plugins: bound hook spawns, scrub copilot bypass-recorder env, and scan every plugin test dir
